tools.name: get_content_calendar
tools.description: Audience Resolver publisher API: get_content_calendar

tools.name: update_content_calendar
tools.description: Patch calendar title, default_targets, or default_post_times.

tools.name: delete_content_calendar
tools.description: Audience Resolver publisher API: delete_content_calendar

tools.name: create_calendar_row
tools.description: Add a draft row to a content calendar.

tools.name: update_calendar_row
tools.description: Patch one calendar row (only pass fields you intend to change).

tools.name: delete_calendar_row
tools.description: Remove one post row from a content calendar (does not cancel Nova-queued posts).

tools.name: delete_calendar_rows
tools.description: Remove multiple post rows from a content calendar (does not cancel Nova-queued posts).

tools.name: schedule_calendar_row
tools.description: Schedule one calendar row on Nova. Reads the row Post Type (set via update_calendar_row) and media URL: YouTube short vs video; LinkedIn video vs feed; Instagram reel for video files.

tools.name: schedule_all_calendar_rows
tools.description: Audience Resolver publisher API: schedule_all_calendar_rows

tools.name: upload_publisher_image
tools.description: Upload a PNG/JPEG to the publisher-bound AR project (image_url or small image_base64). Returns asset_id and media_url for row linking.

tools.name: upload_publisher_video
tools.description: Upload a video (mp4/webm/mov, up to 200MB) into the publisher-bound AR project's asset library via video_url. Returns asset_id for linking to a calendar row (linked_asset_id).

tools.name: export_content_calendar_json
tools.description: Pull a content calendar as portable JSON (format_version 1) including rows and default_targets. Save calendar_bundle for git or edit offline.

tools.name: import_content_calendar_json
tools.description: Push portable calendar JSON: calendar_import_mode create (new calendar) or replace (clear rows on replace_calendar_id, keep same id). Resolves twitter usernames like usecodenaija and NVA_AI to account_id.

tools.name: list_twitter_accounts
tools.description: Audience Resolver publisher API: list_twitter_accounts

tools.name: list_social_accounts
tools.description: List Nova-linked social accounts for a platform (twitter, instagram, facebook, tiktok, linkedin, youtube).

tools.name: nova_generate_calendar
tools.description: Draft a content calendar with Nova (returns rows markdown; persist with create_content_calendar + create_calendar_row). Requires Nova API key in AR Settings.

tools.name: import_webpage_calendar
tools.description: Import a public webpage into a calendar draft (Nova extract + LLM). Requires Nova API key in AR Settings.

tools.name: get_row_generate_asset_context
tools.description: Row context for AI image/video generation on a calendar row.

tools.name: generate_calendar_row_asset
tools.description: Generate and optionally attach an image or video asset for a calendar row.

tools.name: regenerate_calendar_row_asset
tools.description: Regenerate row asset with new instructions (same as generate with required instructions).

tools.name: list_publishing_history
tools.description: List publishing history for the project (syncs pending items from Nova). Requires publisher_pid in the URL path (tenant global after create_project), same as schedule_calendar_row.

tools.name: get_publishing_history_item
tools.description: Get one publishing history record by id.

tools.name: cancel_publishing_history
tools.description: Cancel a scheduled or pending publish (Nova + local history). Only works when history status is pending, publishing, or scheduled; published rows return not cancellable. Uses publisher_pid in the URL path (same as schedule).

tools.name: unschedule_calendar_row
tools.description: Unschedule one calendar row: cancel linked publishing history when still cancellable, then set row back to draft (clears publishing_history_id and scheduled_at). Prefer this over PATCH scheduled_at alone.

tools.name: list_project_assets
tools.description: List project media assets in the library (optional asset_type filter).

tools.name: asset_from_drive
tools.description: Copy an image or video already uploaded to the project Files drive (via upload_project_drive_file) into the asset library, so it can be linked to a calendar row as linked_asset_id. Does not remove the drive file.

tools.name: get_project_asset
tools.description: Get one project asset by id.

tools.name: update_project_asset
tools.description: Update caption, prompt, or guidelines on a project asset.

tools.name: delete_project_asset
tools.description: Delete a project asset from the library.

tools.name: cancel_project_asset
tools.description: Cancel in-progress generation for a project asset.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List Audience Resolver projects you can access with the publisher key.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a project and start background audience research.

tools.name: get_project_initialization_status
tools.description: Poll project initialization and research progress.

tools.name: generate_research
tools.description: Start or extend research for a project.

tools.name: get_research_status
tools.description: Get research job status for a project.

tools.name: list_research_reports
tools.description: List research report files for a project.

tools.name: list_project_drive
tools.description: List the project Files tab drive: audience research .md reports plus uploaded context files (images, video, pdf, md, txt).

tools.name: upload_project_drive_file
tools.description: Upload a file into the project Files tab (context/). Use file_url (https) for large files. Returns drive file id for calendar generate context attachment.

tools.name: publish_asset
tools.description: Publish or schedule an asset to one or many connected social accounts. Pass publish_targets for several accounts at once (each with its own optional caption and post type), or publish_platform + publish_account_id for one. publish_scheduled_at schedules the post; leave it empty to publish now.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "regenerate_calendar_row_asset" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Regenerate row asset with new instructions (same as generate with required instructions).

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp-audience-resolver" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_publishing_history · Private data: schedule_calendar_row, nova_generate_calendar, import_webpage_calendar, get_publishing_history_item, asset_from_drive, list_research_reports, list_project_drive, upload_project_drive_file · Public sink: delete_calendar_row, delete_calendar_rows, schedule_calendar_row, upload_publisher_image, upload_publisher_video, cancel_publishing_history, upload_project_drive_file, publish_asset · Destructive: delete_content_calendar, delete_calendar_row, delete_calendar_rows, asset_from_drive, delete_project_asset.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_publishing_history · Private data: schedule_calendar_row, nova_generate_calendar, import_webpage_calendar, get_publishing_history_item, asset_from_drive, list_research_reports, list_project_drive, upload_project_drive_file · Public sink: delete_calendar_row, delete_calendar_rows, schedule_calendar_row, upload_publisher_image, upload_publisher_video, cancel_publishing_history, upload_project_drive_file, publish_asset · Destructive: delete_content_calendar, delete_calendar_row, delete_calendar_rows, asset_from_drive, delete_project_asset

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
